description.value:
A segmented stinger-tail grown off the base of the spine, from Spiderlands stock. Melee Strike: tail, reach 10 feet, 1d6 piercing plus 1d6 persistent poison, agile, finesse. Once per minute, on a hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC (or DC 14 + half your level) or be enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

Rider: It stands guard while you sleep. If a creature comes within 10 feet as you rest, the tail Strikes at it on its own — the GM rolls, it wakes you, and it does not check whether the target was a friend.

cinderfall.incomplete: The persistent poison rider, the once-per-minute enfeeble-on-hit rider, and the sleep-guard auto-attack all have no hook: a Strike's damage line can't itself carry a persistent-poison rider or a secondary save-for-a-condition rider (those need a granted effect keyed to the strike, the equipment pass's established gap class), and an item attacking on its own while you sleep has no representation at all.
